work: Reconciled the hidden Serlesbahnen Mieders Park and its one hidden Sommerrodelbahn park item with the independent Serlesblitz alpine coaster. Migrated via the official editor, retired the legacy Park and park item, published the standalone with one licensed photograph and eight localized descriptions, verified all eight public routes and image binary HTTP 200, then published a Facebook announcement.
qualification: The retired Park held only one hidden attraction and no other park editorial content. The summer toboggan is a separately identifiable fixed ride in the wider Serlesbahnen mountain area; migration preserves legacy site identifiers in the backlog.
